tldr: For a prospective pair-intervention experiment with a planted cycle and dense reservoir, the original matching formation and exact balanced assignment admit a joint critical defect, occupation and usual-contrast law with a refined compact-uniform certificate \(\widetilde A_*G^{-1/2}\). Classical periodic-Ising theory supplies the occupation components. Exact matching counts, forbidden-chord rejection and a beta-binomial rank coupling connect them to the original experiment. The result includes stable independent reservoir noise, full experimental variance, certified distribution evaluation and Gaussian-failure consequences. Refined finite-size tolerance certificates are quadratic; no optimal-rate or Gaussian-sufficiency theorem is claimed.
